title: Earth as incomplete principle; chaos; Cap. 26 toward Hexaemeron
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN, On ye Hexaemeron or ye works belonging toward ye six days, follows. The Spirit belonging toward God was brooding upon ye waters — Genesis 1:2 — preparing ye matter toward ye Hexaemeron. but a created subject out from that same which God on ye following days brought forth distinct species — that chaos was not eternal matter. plus darkness was upon ye face belonging toward ye deep — Genesis 1:2 — it was without form plus void. as stands as clear out from chapter 24 — earth in ye beginning was produced incompletely.
pass_b_english: Earth in the beginning was produced incompletely, as is clear from chapter 24. It was without form and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep — Genesis 1:2.

That chaos was not eternal matter, but a created subject from which God on the following days brought forth distinct species. The Spirit of God was brooding upon the waters — Genesis 1:2 — preparing the matter for the Hexaemeron.
CHAPTER TWENTY-SEVEN, On the Hexaemeron or the works of the six days, follows.
source_text: Terra in principio producta fuit incompletè, ut liquet ex cap. 24. Erat inanis et vacua, et tenebrae erant super faciem abyssi — Gen. I.2. Chaos illud non fuit materia aeterna, sed creatum subjectum ex quo Deus sequentibus diebus distinctas species eduxit. Spiritus Dei incubabat aquis — Gen. I.2 — praeparans materiam ad Hexaemeron. CAPUT VIGESIMUM SEPTIMUM, De Hexaemero sive operibus sex dierum, sequitur.
